title: Culturing, Transfection and Lipid Uptake Assay in HeLa-CDC50A-OE Cells
author: Klara KTS Scholtissek
materials: Replace PBS with 300 µl serum free DMEM
Monitor expression by fluorescence if available
Detach cells by pipetting of the plate

steps.title: Detach cells with trypsin
steps.instruction: Remove existing DMEM, wash cells with 1 ml PBS, add trypsin, incubate 5 min at 37 °C, then neutralize with DMEM containing 10 % FBS and 1 % Pen‑Strep.

steps.title: Seed cells for assay
steps.instruction: Dilute detached cells to 90 000 cells ml⁻¹ in DMEM, dispense 1 ml per well of a 12‑well plate, and incubate 16–24 h at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Transfect cells with PEI
steps.instruction: For each well, mix 55 µl serum‑free DMEM with 1 µg DNA (tube 1) and 55 µl serum‑free DMEM with 5 µg PEI (tube 2); vortex after each pipetting, incubate 15 min at room temperature, combine the two mixtures, vortex again, incubate 15 min at room temperature, remove DMEM from the seeded cells, wash with 1 ml PBS, add the transfection mixture while gently shaking, and incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Perform lipid uptake assay
steps.instruction: Replace the transfection medium with fresh DMEM containing 10 % FBS and 1 % Pen‑Strep, then remove DMEM, wash with 1 ml PBS, add HBSS containing 1 µM NBD‑labeled lipid (pre‑equilibrated to 15 °C), incubate 20 min at 15 °C, replace the lipid solution with HBSS containing 2.5 % BSA and 15 mM EDTA, and keep the cells on ice thereafter.

steps.title: Prepare cells for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Pass the cell suspension through a filter mesh into a flow‑cytometry tube and add DRAQ7 to a final concentration of 3 µM, vortexing gently.

steps.title: Acquire and analyze flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Run samples on a NovoCyte Quanteon 4025 flow cytometer (405 nm, 488 nm, 561 nm, 637 nm lasers; 25 detectors; software NovoExpress v1.6.2). Exclude dead cells using DRAQ7, collect 2 000–10 000 events in the mCherry‑positive or expression‑positive gate. Set detector settings: BFP – 405 nm, V445, gain 500; NBD – 488 nm, B530; mCherry – 561 nm, Y615; DRAQ7 – 637 nm, R695. Normalize lipid uptake by dividing the median NBD‑A fluorescence by the median mCherry‑A fluorescence of the same population.
